description: Hypothesis: parallelizing causal convolution across tokens and fusing FP32 convolution/SiLU, Q/K normalization and gates reduces DeltaNet prefill preparation cost. A separate carry update preserves incoming history; tiny blocks and verification retain the original path. Same affine-8 group-64 v2 target weights, BF16 scale/bias and draft weights, FP16 KV/operands, FP32 intermediates/state/accumulation, staged8 recurrence, DFlash2, prefix checkpoints, 2048-token chunks and 32768-token context. Development comparisons against freshly merged main show 1.90% / 1.41% higher 10K / 30K throughput versus a later baseline, with bitwise fixture and model-smoke checks; these are not official scores. Run all seven Full-profile tests. Evaluation revision advances to merged main with the same definition and all driver hashes.
